h1: ROT-4SS Premium Stainless Steel Pressure Tank
bodyHtml:
ROT-4SS Premium Stainless Steel Pressure Tank

18-Liter (4.5 Gallon) 304 Stainless Steel Tank for Food Equipment, Beverages & Marine Applications | Aquasky PREMIUM-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

ROT-4SS is an elite-tier pressure tank constructed entirely from high-quality 304 stainless steel, engineered specifically to deliver exceptional durability and anti-rust performance in harsh environments and specialized commercial applications.

ROT-4SS has a total volume of 18 liters (4.5 gallons). The tank is designed for a maximum operating pressure of 7 bar (100 psi) and a maximum operating temperature of 90 °C (194 °F). To ensure stable and highly reliable system performance, it is factory pre-charged to 0.5-0.7 bar (7-10 psi) with nitrogen gas.

With a diameter of 28.0 cm (11.0 inches) and a height of 34.7 cm (13.7 inches), this premium tank features a meticulously polished mirror-like surface, making it the perfect choice for demanding environments that require both peak functionality and pristine aesthetics.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The ROT-4SS is an 18-liter (4.5 gallon) premium diaphragm pressure tank that represents the peak of Aquasky's engineering. Unlike standard carbon steel tanks, the PREMIUM-PLUS Series is manufactured entirely from top-grade 304 stainless steel. This ultimate anti-rust construction ensures that the ROT-4SS thrives in specialized applications and harsh environments where standard tanks would rapidly degrade, such as food processing equipment, commercial beverage dispensing, and sea water storage on yachts.

Inside the flawlessly polished mirror-finish shell, the ROT-4SS utilizes a heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm designed for long-lasting resilience. The superior materials guarantee that the tank remains exceptionally durable and hygienic, catering specifically to premium users who demand the highest quality and absolute reliability without compromise.

Manufactured with precision, the Aquasky PREMIUM-PLUS tanks are designed to exceed expectations in both performance and longevity, making them an indispensable asset for elite commercial, industrial, and marine systems.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • All-304 Stainless Steel Construction provides the ultimate anti-rust protection against harsh environmental factors and corrosive elements.
  • Mirror-Polished Surface delivers a premium, easy-to-clean aesthetic ideal for sanitary environments.
  • 1/4" NPT Stainless Steel Connection ensures a secure, leak-free, and highly durable integration into specialized plumbing systems.
  • Heavy-Duty Butyl Rubber Diaphragm designed to maintain optimal pressure levels and withstand frequent cycling.
  • Factory Nitrogen Pre-charge (7~10 PSI) avoids the pressure loss common with standard air, guaranteeing long-term stability.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the PREMIUM-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

The ROT-4SS operates by storing fluid securely against the heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm, separated from the pre-charged nitrogen air cushion. As system pressure fluctuates, the nitrogen compresses to safely absorb and maintain pressure levels. What sets the PREMIUM-PLUS apart is its exterior resilience; the 304 stainless steel shell allows this internal mechanical process to occur flawlessly even when the tank is constantly exposed to sea spray, high humidity, or rigorous sanitary washdowns.

Key benefits

  • Thrives in harsh environments where standard carbon steel tanks would quickly rust and fail.
  • Exceptional hygiene and cleanliness, making it the perfect choice for the food and beverage industry.
  • Unmatched aesthetic appeal for high-end installations thanks to its mirror-polished exterior.
  • Dependable, long-lasting performance engineered specifically for premium users demanding top-tier quality

Typical Applications

  • Food processing and preparation equipment
  • Commercial beverage dispensing systems
  • Yacht and marine applications, including sea water storage
  • Any premium installation requiring absolute anti-rust properties

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : Why should I choose the ROT-4SS over a standard steel pressure tank?

A: The ROT-4SS is part of our PREMIUM-PLUS series, meaning it is constructed entirely from high-quality 304 stainless steel. This provides incredible anti-rust capabilities and a polished mirror finish, making it mandatory for harsh environments, food equipment, beverage systems, or yacht installations where standard tanks would rapidly degrade.

Q2 : What is the maximum operating pressure and temperature for the ROT-4SS?

A: The ROT-4SS is engineered to safely handle a maximum operating pressure of 100 PSI (7 bar) and can withstand operating temperatures up to 90 °C (194 °F).

Q3 : Can the ROT-4SS be used for marine applications?

A : Yes, absolutely. The 304 stainless steel construction makes the ROT-4SS highly resistant to corrosion, making it perfectly suited for storing sea water on yachts or operating in highly saline coastal environments.
